action.action-desc: Mr. Mackenzie submitted the following resolution; which was referred to the Committee on Rules

form.official-title: Amending the Rules of the House of Representatives to restrict a recorded vote on any question put before the House after a certain hour, and for other purposes.

section.text: This resolution may be cited as the Protecting Deliberative Process in the House Resolution.

section.header: Restrictions on recorded votes in the House
section.text: Rule XXIX of the Rules of the House of Representatives is amended by adding at the end the following new clause:

rules-clause.text: Notwithstanding any other rule of the House, no recorded vote conducted pursuant to the voting procedures under rule XX may be ordered on or after 11:00 p.m. on any day the House is in session unless it is determined, by an affirmative vote of at least three-fourths of the Members voting, a quorum being present, that exigent circumstances exist such that an exception to this requirement is warranted.
